blur_detection.description: The receipt shows clear, readable text with good edge definition throughout most of the document.
blur_detection.recommendation: No action needed for blur correction as text is sufficiently clear for OCR processing.

contrast_assessment.description: The receipt exhibits good black text against light background with sufficient contrast for readability.
contrast_assessment.recommendation: No contrast enhancement needed for successful text extraction.

glare_identification.description: No significant glare or bright reflections that obscure text content are present on the receipt.
glare_identification.recommendation: No action needed regarding glare management.

water_stains.description: No visible water damage, staining or discoloration affecting text legibility is present.

tears_or_folds.description: Minor creases or fold lines are visible but do not significantly impact text readability.
tears_or_folds.recommendation: No significant action needed as the minor creases don't impair data extraction.

cut_off_detection.description: All edges of the receipt appear to be fully captured with no cut-off content.
cut_off_detection.recommendation: No adjustment needed for document framing.

missing_sections.description: The receipt appears complete with header, line items, totals, and footer information all present.
missing_sections.recommendation: No additional capture needed as all typical receipt sections are visible.

obstructions.description: No visible fingers, shadows or objects obstructing the receipt content.
